1603-4808-4812-5131.description:

Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat.

When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.

Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.

1479-4493-5621.description:
Create a nonlegendary copy of Kodama of the East Tree using Irenicus's Vile Duplication (this may involve additional steps depending on the card used).
Play Arid Archway.
When Arid Archway enters, both Kodama of the East Trees and Arid Archway trigger.
Resolve the nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the legendary Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Arid Archway onto the battlefield.
The nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree and Arid Archway trigger.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree's trigger, putting Arid Archway onto the battlefield.
The legendary Kodama of the East Tree and Arid Archway trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

676-1987-2493.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
676-1987-2493.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creature tokens.
676-1987-2493.description:

Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Archaeomancer.
When Archaeomancer enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3532-5078-6608-7753.description:

Jace's Projection triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

2523-2869-3122.description:
Cast Undercover Operative by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Ratadrabik.
Put Undercover Operative into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Undercover Operative dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Undercover Operative that is a copy of Ratadrabik but is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 2 using the Undercover Operative token instead.
2523-2869-3122.notes: This combo produces a mandatory infinite loop that'll cause the game to end in a draw if it isn't interacted with.

Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
If the sacrificed creature was a Devil token, it triggers when it dies, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat each combat phase.

Lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{G}.
You control a Plains.
277-3293-5226-5721.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{G}.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd and Tiller Engine trigger that many times.
Resolve all Tiller Engine triggers, untapping each land that entered.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all other Emeria Shepherd triggers, returning any number of nonland permanents from your graveyard to either your hand or the battlefield.
Repeat.
277-3293-5226-5721.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard to the battlefield if you control two or more Plains. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Shimmering Wings by paying {U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3399-5124.manaNeeded: {4}{W} or you control two untapped creatures that share a creature type with Stormfront Riders
3399-5124.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
3399-5124.description:

Otherwise, cast Stormfront Riders by paying {4}{W}.
Stormfront Riders enters the battlefield, returning itself and any other creature you control from the battlefield to your hand.

Stormfront Riders enters the battlefield, returning itself and a Soldier token from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 4.
